name: Okita Souji
source:
Commanding officer of Shinsengumi Regiment No. 1
Training school: Tennen Rishin-ryū (fully licensed)

"Spring has always been my favorite season. As long as we endure the cold of winter, spring will always come around."
translation:
新选组一番队队长。
修行道场：天然理心流（皆传）

“我一直最喜欢春天。只要熬过寒冬，春天就一定会到来。”
